brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on a wall
requirements.evidence: 3-cell wide rack (piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full plus level 1) with keyhole hangers on rear face slot 4 (accessory:0#-1,0#4, accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4) for screw-mount on wall

requirements.requirement: With hooks for small hand tools
requirements.evidence: Three hook plates hex-acc-hook on front face slot 1 (accessory:0#-1,0#1, accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#1,0#1), each with two hooks side-by-side; second level added for clearance

Hooks accept cable-coil, tape-gaffer, FPV goggles per configurator, but addProp refused PROP_NO_REST due to bench intersection in this low-height test position; physical rack geometry is correct for hanging

finish.summary: Two-storey, 3-wide wall rack with 3 rear keyhole hangers (slot 4) and 3 front hook plates (6 hooks total). House rules capped and joint-bolted. Hanging props validated by allowed types but configurator blocks placement through bench at this height.

lines.label: Edge cap · female, two stories tall
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
